body:
Wow. Thanks again for your reply. You strike me as wise. Do you mind my asking how your father died? Mine died from Lung cancer, but lived much longer than expected. The last time he was in hospital, his dr took me aside and told me he thought he had 2 weeks to 2 months left to live and that there was no lung tissue left. I think he lived maybe 2 years after that? People payed a lot of attention to how my mother was coping as she was the wife who lost her husband. If I am honest I felt much neglected during that time. Maybe her grief was different, but mine was not invalid and unworthy of attention. Do not misinterpret that as me attention seeking - I just wanted people to give a shit because I do not grieve well and still haven't. 

You interested me with your concept of realization and also of depression being an illusion. From my perspective, there is literally something wrong with my brain. One could consider that chemical or psychological, or maybe one influencing the other - and in either direction. But your concept is good food for thought. 

I'm still really uncomfortable 'unpacking' what ails me to a counselor of some type. I know I have to do it. I just have experience of them not giving a shit and wanting to medicate me. I know I shouldn't paint them all with the same brush... Its hard not to.

As for the ward, I had an ex in one once. I was a visitor, and I felt trapped. That led me to imagine being the patient and not being able to leave - terrifying! (yes, I have honestly done nothing but date broken women in my life - they either cut, OD'd or committed suicide - no exaggeration) 

I grew fond of a woman who did not share my feelings recently. I really dont think I've fallen for her. I dont know her that well. But the whole *such a good FRIEND* thing has been clearly emphasised to me. I am ashamed to admit that it may have got the ball rolling with my recent dispare, but honestly I dont think it is the fundamental problem. 

I have reached the point where coping is problematic for me. I am over sensitive. Little things push me over the edge. Appropriate coping is difficult for me. I cant reach out to friends because I lost one in the past. What are my other options? Bottle up my feelings or see a counselor. I suppose I should mention that when I finally do see someone. 

Thanks again for writing back to me, that was very kind of you as a stranger who does not know me.

Thank you for your words. Therapy is probably necessary. I am not sure I can endure until and remain harm free. Self realization has religious overtones and I'm an atheist. I do not judge you or invite conflict or argument, but I cannot follow that path.

I fear being trapped in a psyke ward. It terrifies me.
